title: cephaelis emetica
intro: Cephaelis emetica, commonly known as Ipecacuanha, is a plant native to South America and has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. It is valued for its emetic properties, which induce vomiting, making it useful in treating conditions such as nausea, diarrhea, and poisoning. The plant's health benefits include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and relieve respiratory issues like bronchitis and coughs. Cephaelis emetica contains bioactive constituents like emetine and cephaeline, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of inducing emesis and treating gastrointestinal and respiratory disorders.
